narration.text: I'm Adrian, founder of ApplyArc, a UK job-search startup that existed before this hackathon. Everything here was built during it, on Meta's models.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 1, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: A real council job advert says: "Using AI? Please follow our guidance to ensure your application reflects your own knowledge and experience."
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 2, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: Ana is fictional. Her problem is real. Three years in a Leeds care home, working English every day, and a form that wants written English.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 3, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py
founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 4, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: Ana (synthetic voice, in Portuguese): “Chamo-me Ana. Eu trabalho há três anos num lar em Leeds…”
narration.note: Ana's notes clip: the first 6.0 s of ana-pt-notes.wav (sha256 ba636530ebbf…), on the player running (notes-play)

narration.text: Muse Voice Transcribe writes it down, live, keeping her English care words in English. She checks her words first.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 5, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: Muse Wonder turns her words into facts. Each one quotes her exact Portuguese. Code checks it, word for word. The English meaning sits underneath. She confirms both.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 6, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: Wonder checks the council's ten points and finds the one she didn't cover: dignity and respect. It asks in Portuguese.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 7, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: Ana (synthetic voice, in Portuguese): “Para mim, dignidade é bater à porta antes de entrar…”
narration.note: Ana's answer clip: the first 4.0 s of ana-pt-answer.wav (sha256 91b684c57fb5…), on Hearing her answer… (answer-clip)

narration.text: Wonder drafts her supporting evidence and a short letter, in English. Every factual sentence cites a fact she confirmed, and a second Wonder call checks it against her Portuguese.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 8, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: Then she remembers: only two of her three years were nights. She says it once.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 9, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: Ana (synthetic voice, in Portuguese): “Correção: os turnos da noite foram dois anos, não três…”
narration.note: Ana's correction clip: the first 4.0 s of ana-pt-correction.wav (sha256 351de469faec…), on her correction (correction-play)

narration.text: Wonder spots the contradiction and asks which is right. She picks the correction. Only the sentences that cited the old fact reopen, in both documents.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 10, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: Nothing gets submitted for her: the pack is stamped NOT SUBMITTED. The employer gets one page where every factual sentence opens her Portuguese words.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 11, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: What Meta did, step by step: model, host and Meta's request ids. Both models are weeks old. A verifier re-checks the record without calling a model.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 12, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: The same loop runs on Meta's open weights, Muse Spark Open, on Modal, so a care provider chooses where it runs.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 13, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py

narration.text: That's ApplyArc Evidence. Who pays? Councils and care employers who need applications in the applicant's own words. It never screens, ranks or submits anything.
narration.note: founder: narration-20261104-134849Z.wav segment 14, cleaned by narrate-swap-ana.py
